title: phlegmariurus reflexus var. minor
intro: Phlegmariurus reflexus var. minor, commonly known as a type of club moss, is a plant species belonging to the Lycopodiaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antipyretic properties, which may aid in reducing fever and relieving pain. The therapeutic actions of Phlegmariurus reflexus var. minor include its antioxidant and antimicrobial effects, which can help protect against oxidative stress and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
